name: obsidian-scripture-thread
description: Obsidian plugin: convert plain-text Bible references into links as you write or on demand, see your previous notes about a verse, and frame paragraphs that cite Bible references.

scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.release: npm run check && gh release create "$npm_package_version" main.js manifest.json styles.css --verify-tag --title "$npm_package_version" --notes "See CHANGELOG.md for what changed." --generate-notes
